actual_suppliers.current_G: n07a_inverseChart_positive_jets hD hT href hcur hinterval hphysical chooses one loss before n. At fixed z, multiply each sampled envelope by the finite nonnegative scalar 1+parameterGrading S ((n-1)+loss) z; const/mul retain N07aSampleSubpower T K.

actual_suppliers.inverse_jacobian: n07a_actual_inverseChart_jacobian_abs already takes hgeom. Its proof uses actual two-sided inverse differential identities, hgeom.domains and hgeom.charts only.
actual_suppliers.determinant_envelope: n07a_planeJacobian_fixedEnvelope_of_positiveJets plus .abs uses only positive G jets and qualitative nonzero determinant. No quantitative determinant lower bound or reciprocal determinant estimate is required.

geometry_only_extraction.exact_algebra: On V, R(y)=(H_current(G y)/|J_Fcurrent(G y)|)^(-1), and |J_G(y)|=|J_Fcurrent(G y)|^(-1), hence R(y)*|J_G(y)|=(H_current(G y))^(-1).
geometry_only_extraction.nonzero_inputs: Both H_current(G y)>0 and J_Fcurrent(G y)≠0 come from hgeom.charts at the actual mapped point G y.
geometry_only_extraction.necessary_explicit_local_result: Also return ContDiffOn of y ↦ (H_current(G y))^(-1) on V. Derive it by composing the actual height smoothness with G and its MapsTo, then inv using the actual positive height. Do not infer smoothness from a numerical envelope.

order_and_type_check.G: positive orders 1..3 only for requested final prefix
order_and_type_check.Q: Q=H_reference*((R*|J_G|)∘F) on W; standard envelope comp permits outer order zero, which is genuinely supplied.
order_and_type_check.tau: tau=G∘F; use the positive-only partition argument for n>0. For each OrderedFinpartition n, length_pos hn and partSize_pos supply the required strictly positive outer/inner orders.
order_and_type_check.value_membership_in_place_of_value_norm: The only zeroth-order use of F is F p∈V, used to apply outer bounds at the actual point; no norm bound on F p or G y is introduced.
order_and_type_check.partial_function_note: For the final literal Q and tau functions, use explicit full-function equality or open EqOn/congr. Do not rely on unfolding an unapplied composition under iteratedFDeriv.
order_and_type_check.local_instances: Reuse the actual N07a nonlinear parameter/direction local instance stanza and open scoped ContDiff/BigOperators from the cited suppliers; these are typing setup, not new hypotheses.
